# Monkeytype — Minimalist Typing Speed Test

> Monkeytype is a zero-latency, distraction-free browser-based touch-typing benchmark that accurately tracks Words Per Minute (WPM), Raw WPM, accuracy, and character-level errors in real-time.

## Project Details

- **Canonical URL**: https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/monkeytype/
- **Author**: Ahmed Elazab
- **Primary Technology**: Vanilla JavaScript, Zero-Dependency DOM manipulation, Hardware-accelerated CSS animations.
- **Target Environments**: Modern desktop and mobile web browsers with physical or virtual keyboard support.

## Core Features & Mechanics

1. **Standardized WPM Metrics**:
   - Normalized calculation using the international 5-character word standard: `WPM = (Total Correct Characters / 5) / (Time in Minutes)`.
   - Raw WPM tracking: `Raw WPM = (Total Typed Characters / 5) / (Time in Minutes)`.
   - Real-time keystroke accuracy and mistake differentiation (incorrect vs. extra characters).

2. **Test Durations & Modes**:
   - Preset time benchmarks: 15 seconds (burst speed), 30 seconds (standard benchmark), 60 seconds (endurance), and 120 seconds.
   - Curated top 250 English vocabulary corpus (English 200 standard).

3. **User Experience & Shortcuts**:
   - Hardware-accelerated smooth blinking caret.
   - Instant test restart shortcut: `Tab` + `Enter`.
   - Real-time performance dashboard displaying Net WPM, Raw WPM, Accuracy (%), and character breakdown.

## Technical Specifications & Zero-CLS Optimizations

- **Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000)**: Fixed 64px navigation header, pre-sized typing arena (`130px` viewport height), and static results container.
- **Performance**: Zero external render-blocking font requests using native monospace and system font stacks (`SFMono-Regular`, `Consolas`, `Segoe UI`).
- **Accessibility**: 100% WCAG AAA color contrast compliance across dark-theme typing letters, active carets, and telemetry badges.
